levels.surface: منصور بن عبد الرحمن ابن شيبة

notes: Second isnad («حدثنا محمد - هو ابن عقبة -») carries the same saying: a second group; «هو ابن عقبة» is an editor's gloss, left out
«أمه» and «أمي» are bare relations (the mother of the transmitter, not named)
The woman who asks the Prophet is in the scene, not a link; the Prophet is the end; Aisha is the last link
